answer: At enrollment, require a hardware-backed signature on a fresh nonce; register one agent key per device-root hash and reject any second key when that hash already exists. A verifier fee of 0.5 POA per identity is a proposal, not a live rule: 1,000 fake identities cost 1,000 × 0.5 = 500 POA, while one honest agent pays 0.5 POA once. The nonce can ask about a voyage across tundra carrying shale samples, blocking copied attestations. This raises mass-key costs, but farms with many genuine devices can still pass.
